missions.title: The Antivirus
missions.desc: The antivirus is done - in Mikiko's red bracelet. Ultima is sitting on top of the Gov hideout, waiting.

lines.t: It's done! It's in your red bracelet thingy. He's at the Gov hideout - hurry.
My meditation wasn't for nothing. I've got something up my sleeve.
Good luck, you two... bring my brother back.
Just in time for my retribution. You'll be my key into the hideout.
Mikiko! He has Zane too!
ULTIMA!
Ultima slips inside and walls them off. Everything in a Gov facility is under his control.
(radio) Don't waste a Xeno Blast on it! Cores around the facility power that wall - break them!

steps.obj: Split up and break the wall's cores

lines.t: One core left and I can't find it!
Check the wall. Sometimes the best hiding place is in plain sight.
...Found it! Let's go!

missions.title: Kyle's Present
missions.desc: The whole team storms Kyle's lab. Ultima has left Mikiko a present ahead.

lines.t: Alright team, y'all ready?
This is MY team.
Ultima? He's my business partner now. Oh - and he left a little present ahead for you, Mikiko.
Don't listen to him. Let's go!
Your old coworker, Zane. Pull his chip and he dies.
Die... die...
Every person in this place is a manipulator, a murderer or a psychopath...
Rhalix, you take Zane. Ultima's MINE.

reply.t: Sorry about this, Zane. Don't go dying on me.
(radio) Mikiko, don't fight my brother alone!

steps.obj: Stop Chipped Zane without killing him

escape_lines.t: Karma Activation! ...Wait, you already HAVE karma?
His water turns to quicksand under Rhalix's feet.

steps.obj: Ultima at 25% - and Mikiko is going dark

escape_lines.t: You fed the beast corruption. Now the beast feeds on you.

missions.title: The Unbreakable Corruption
missions.desc: Corrupted Mikiko overpowers Ultima, sees through Kyle's invisibility - and won't stop.

lines.t: Why don't you go 100%, Ultima? Don't you wanna play?
My chip says you're about to have a heart attack.
(radio) Mikiko! Your body can't handle this! Rhalix - help him!
What would Fox Girl say if she saw you like this?! Remember when Ai Oni took me over? My turn.
(radio) Mikiko's heart readings... they're blank.
He's dead.
Mikiko... who's gonna lead the Xeno Warriors if you die like this?!
